primitives.verbatim_quote: Let δ be a positive number such that 4δ < 2μ(E) - e, and let C be a compact subset of E such that μ(E) — δ < μ(C).

primitives.assumptions: E has finite positive measure; C is compact and contained in E.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When μ(E) - δ ≥ μ(C), compactness constraint fails.
